question: For each of the five transformer pads shown on this electrical plan, can you identify which side appears to have the access door (typically the side facing an open area or away from walls)? And what is the approximate distance from the access door side to the nearest building or obstruction?
checklistItemText: Transformer pad hot-stick use area (access door side) lacks minimum 10-foot clearance to open area or adjacent building/structure
classifierReasoning: Although the agent question begins with a presence/identification sub-task (locating access doors), the primary and explicit request is for distance measurement from the access door side to the nearest building or obstruction—which directly addresses the 10-foot clearance requirement. The agent is asking for the actual clearance distances needed to verify compliance.
